description: Indeterminate wait indicator. For a measurable process use ProgressBar instead.

size.description: Diameter. 'sm' is --icon-sm exactly, so a spinner at that size sits inline with control text.

tone.description: Colour of the ring. 'on-accent' inside a filled button; 'accent' on a page surface.

label.description: Accessible name, announced by the status role. Say what is loading when you can.
